# Terrarium

> Terrarium turns a fresh Ubuntu VPS into a hardened host for isolated LXD system containers on ZFS, with automatic snapshots, S3 backups, Traefik routing from container labels, and OIDC single sign-on.

## For agents

- [agents.md](https://terrarium.terion.name/agents.md): the complete single-file guide to installing, operating, and building on Terrarium

- [Installation](https://terrarium.terion.name/getting-started/installation)

- [Backups and restore](https://terrarium.terion.name/operations/backups-and-restore)

- [Guides](https://terrarium.terion.name/guides/)
